mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (recipient_user_id, application_id, match_id, join_request_id, club_id, report_id, notification_type, title, body, created_at) VALUES (#{recipientUserId}, #{applicationId}, #{matchId}, #{joinRequestId}, #{clubId}, #{reportId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id AS notificationId ,n.recipient_user_id AS recipientUserId ,n.application_id AS applicationId ,n.match_id AS matchId ,n.join_request_id AS joinRequestId ,COALESCE(n.club_id, cj.club_id) AS clubId ,n.report_id AS reportId ,n.notification_type AS type ,n.title ,n.body ,n.created_at AS createdAt ,n.read_at AS readAt FROM notification n LEFT JOIN club_join_request cj ON cj.request_id = n.join_request_id WHERE n.recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND (n.read_at IS NULL OR n.notification_id IN ( SELECT recent.notification_id FROM (SELECT notification_id FROM notification WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) recent )) ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.notification_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND read_at IS NULL
SELECT user_id AS userId ,role FROM app_user WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (UPPER(role) LIKE '%ADMIN%' OR role LIKE '%시스템 관리자%') ORDER BY user_id
